summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  ### What I looked at (read-only) - `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` — loads via `GET /watchlist`, saves via `POST/DELETE` calls, no localStorage/sessionStorage fallback, requests sent with `credentials: "include"`. - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` — every route requires a valid session cookie, resolves `X-User-Id` from it, and every DB query is scoped `WHERE user_id = ?`. - `db/auth.ts` — login always resolves to the same stable `user.id` keyed by email; sessions last 30 days. - `server.ts` CORS config — correct
